about_gameP1: Beast of Reincarnation: Awakening ist ein Anime-Open-World-Action-RPG, das von Hound13 Inc. entwickelt und mit der Unreal Engine 5 erstellt wurde. Auf dem Kontinent Orbis angesiedelt, steuern die Spieler den Protagonisten Lute und rekrutieren 18 zusätzliche Helden, jeder mit einzigartigen Statuseffekt-Fähigkeiten.
about_gameP2: Das Spiel bietet ein Tag-Combo-Kampfsystem, bei dem 3er-Heldenteams in Echtzeit kämpfen, Statuseffekte stapeln, um Signalfähigkeiten und Wechselsignale auszulösen. Ursprünglich ein koreanisches Mobile-Gacha-Spiel, wurde es von Hound13 komplett als Buy-to-Play-PC-Titel ohne Gacha-Elemente neu entwickelt. Verfügbar auf Steam ab dem 23. Juli 2026.

ailment_airborne_desc: Schleudert Gegner in die Luft für ausgedehnte Jonglier-Kombos und Luftketten
ailment_airborne_effect: Gegner werden nach oben geschleudert und ermöglichen Jonglier-Kombos. Verlängerte Flugzeit ermöglicht mehrere Folgetreffer.
ailment_bleed_desc: Verursacht kontinuierlichen Schaden über Zeit und schwächt Gegner für den Todesstoß
ailment_bleed_effect: Gegner erleiden Schaden über Zeit. Stapeln von Blutung erhöht den Zeitschaden. Effektiv gegen Ziele mit hohen HP.
ailment_freeze_desc: Umschließt Gegner über die Frost-Anzeige mit Eis und hält sie für gezielte Angriffe fest
ailment_freeze_effect: Die Frost-Anzeige füllt sich, wenn Eisschaden zugefügt wird. Wenn sie voll ist, ist der Gegner für 3-5 Sekunden vollständig eingefroren.
ailment_knockdown_desc: Schickt Gegner zu Boden, unterbricht Angriffe und schafft Kombofenster
ailment_knockdown_effect: Gegner werden für 2-3 Sekunden zu Boden geworfen und sind handlungsunfähig. Löst Signalfertigkeit aus, wenn mit anderen Statuseffekten kombiniert.
ailment_shock_desc: Elektrisiert Gegner mit betäubendem Schaden und eröffnet Ketten für Folgekombos
ailment_shock_effect: Gegner sind kurz betäubt und erleiden zusätzlichen Blitzschaden. Kombinierbar mit Niederschlag für verheerende Kettenkombos.
category_advantages_builds: Ein gut gebauter Held übertrifft einen nicht optimierten dramatisch. DPS-Burst-Builds können Bosse mit vollen Signalskill-Ketten mit einem Schlag besiegen. Betäubungs-Lock-Builds halten Feinde permanent handlungsunfähig. Vertrauten-Paarungen bieten zusätzliche Boni, die mit bestimmten Build-Typen synergieren.
category_advantages_guides: Leitfäden basieren auf Community-Tests vor der Veröffentlichung und offiziellen Quellen. Jeder Leitfaden enthält spezifische Strategien und Daten, keine allgemeinen Tipps. Wir decken sowohl Grundlagen für neue Spieler als auch fortgeschrittene Strategien für Endgame-Inhalte ab.

category_intro_builds: Helden-Builds in Beast of Reincarnation: Awakening optimieren den Fertigkeitsbaumpfad, die Ausrüstungswahl und die Vertrauten-Paarungen jedes Helden für maximale Leistung. Der richtige Build kann einen B-Tier-Helden auf wettbewerbsfähiges Niveau heben, während ein schlechter Build das Potenzial eines S-Tier-Helden verschwendet.
category_intro_guides: Leitfäden decken jeden Aspekt von Beast of Reincarnation: Awakening ab — von Anfänger-Tutorials zum Tag-Combo-System bis hin zu fortgeschrittenen Dungeon-Strategien und Vertrauten-Sammelrouten. Egal, ob ihr eure erste Zustandswechsel-Kette lernt oder Endgame-Builds optimiert, unsere Leitfäden haben alles für euch.
category_mechanics_builds: Der Fertigkeitsbaum jedes Helden hat mehrere Pfade. DPS-Builds maximieren den Signalskill-Schaden durch Geschwindigkeit der Zustandswechsel-Anwendung und Combo-Multiplikatoren. Unterstützungs-Builds verbessern die Team-Zustandswechsel-Dauer und Wechselsignal-Fenster. Tank-Builds erhöhen die Überlebensfähigkeit und die Frosteinwirkungs-Laderate für gefrierbasierte CC.
category_mechanics_guides: Unsere Leitfäden sind nach Spielsystemen organisiert, damit ihr genau das findet, was ihr braucht. Anfänger-Leitfäden behandeln das Tag-Combo-System und euer erstes Heldenteam. Kampf-Leitfäden erklären Signalskills und Wechselsignale. Helden-Leitfäden beschreiben Tier-Rankings und optimale Builds. Erkundungs-Leitfäden enthüllen versteckte Inhalte und Vertrauten-Standorte.

Betäubungs-Lock-Builds verlieren an Effektivität gegen Bosse mit Zustandswechsel-Resistenzen. DOT-Druck-Builds haben die niedrigste Obergrenze. Ressourceninvestitionen in einen falschen Build-Pfad können nicht zurückerstattet werden.
category_weaknesses_guides: Spieldaten basieren auf Tests vor der Veröffentlichung und können sich nach dem Launch ändern. Einige Werte (Schadenszahlen, Zustandswechsel-Dauer) können in Patches angepasst werden. Überprüft immer die neuesten Update-Notizen auf Änderungen.

faq_bestHeroes: Wer sind die besten Helden in Beast of Reincarnation: Awakening?
faq_bestHeroes_answer: Zu den S-Klasse-Helden gehören Lute (Niederschlags-DPS), Aria (Schock-Unterstützung), Castella (Luft-Massenkontrolle) und Dana (Einfrier-Panzer). Diese Helden bieten die beste Abdeckung von Statuseffekten und Combo-Potenzial. Sieh dir unsere vollständige Rangliste für detaillierte Bewertungen an.
faq_dlcContent_answer: DLCs bestehen ausschließlich aus kosmetischen Vertrauten – 10 Vertraute, die als DLC erhältlich sind, ohne funktionalen Vorteil gegenüber kostenlosen Vertrauten. Alle 19 Helden und Kernspielinhalte sind im Grundkauf für 29,99 $ enthalten. Helden-Updates nach dem Start (Liza, Jerome, Veronica, Logan) werden kostenlos sein.
faq_familiarFree_answer: Nein. Laut offiziellen Quellen gibt es keinen funktionalen Unterschied zwischen kostenlosen und DLC-Vertrauten. Die 20 kostenlosen Vertrauten, die durch Story und Erkundung erhalten werden, bieten die gleichen Kampf- und Erkundungsboni wie die 10 DLC-Vertrauten.
faq_howManyHeroes: Wie viele Helden gibt es im Spiel?
faq_howManyHeroes_answer: Es gibt 19 spielbare Helden zum Start, mit 4 weiteren Helden (Liza, Jerome, Veronica, Logan), die als kostenlose Ergänzungen nach dem Start geplant sind. Alle Helden sind im Grundkauf enthalten – kein Freischalten oder Gacha erforderlich.
faq_isGacha: Ist Beast of Reincarnation: Awakening ein Gacha-Spiel?
faq_isGacha_answer: Nein. Beast of Reincarnation: Awakening war ursprünglich ein koreanisches Mobile-Gacha-Spiel, aber Hound13 hat es komplett als Buy-to-Play-PC-Spiel neu entwickelt. Alle 19 Helden sind im Kauf für 29,99 $ enthalten. Es gibt keine Gacha-Ziehungen oder Pay-to-Win-Mechaniken. Nur kosmetische Vertrauten-DLCs sind verfügbar.
faq_legalDispute: Worum geht es bei dem Rechtsstreit mit Webzen?
faq_legalDispute_answer: Hound13 hatte einen Vertragsstreit mit dem ehemaligen Publisher Webzen bezüglich der ursprünglichen koreanischen Mobile-Version. Der Streit befindet sich noch im Gerichtsverfahren, betrifft aber nicht die PC-Veröffentlichung von Beast of Reincarnation: Awakening. Hound13 veröffentlicht die PC-Version jetzt selbst.
faq_priceModel_answer: Beast of Reincarnation: Awakening ist Buy-to-Play für 29,99 $. Es gibt kein Gacha, kein Pay-to-Win und kein Abonnement. Alle 19 Helden sind enthalten. Nur kosmetische Vertrauten-DLCs sind käuflich erhältlich. Kaufe vor dem 31. August 2026, um den kostenlosen Abyssal-Direwolf-Vertrauten-Bonus zu erhalten.
faq_riftSystem_answer: Das Riss-System ist ein geplanter Endgame-Inhalt, der in Updates nach der Veröffentlichung erscheinen soll. Details sind begrenzt, aber es wird erwartet, dass es herausfordernde, wiederholbare Inhalte für Helden auf Maximalstufe bietet. Besuchen Sie unsere Updates-Seite für die neuesten Roadmap-Informationen.
faq_signalSkill_answer: Signal-Fähigkeiten sind mächtige Bonusangriffe, die ausgelöst werden, wenn Statuseffekte während Tag-Combos gestapelt werden. Wechselsignale sind spezielle Angriffe, die ausgelöst werden, wenn du Helden im richtigen Moment während einer Combo-Kette wechselst. Zusammen bilden sie die Kernmechanik für Schadensverursachung des Tag-Combo-Systems.
faq_tagComboHow_answer: Das Tag-Combo-System ermöglicht es dir, während des Kampfes in Echtzeit zwischen 3 Helden zu wechseln. Jeder Held wendet einen Statuseffekt an (Niederschlag, Schock, Einfrieren, Luft oder Blutung). Wenn Effekte gestapelt werden, lösen sie Signal-Fähigkeiten und Wechselsignale für Bonusschaden aus. Die Kombination verschiedener Effekte heldenübergreifend erzeugt mächtige Ketten-Combos.

category_intro_bosses: Boss encounters in Beast of Reincarnation are multi-phase battles that test your mastery of ailment stacking, Signal Skill timing, and Reincarnation loop awareness. Each boss has distinct phase transitions, enrage timers, and weakness windows that demand precise execution. From the Blight-corrupted Wardens guarding ancient research facilities to the devastating final encounter with the First Bloom's avatar, every boss fight is a puzzle of pattern recognition and resource management.
category_mechanics_bosses: Boss fights operate on a phase system where each transition introduces new attack patterns, environmental hazards, and occasionally changes the boss's vulnerability to specific Status Ailments. The Blight mechanic is central — bosses absorb ambient Blight energy over time, gradually increasing their attack speed and damage. Reincarnation loops reset boss enrage timers but also restore some boss health, creating a strategic tension between resetting danger and losing progress. Familiar abilities can interrupt specific charge attacks, and the tag combo system enables burst damage windows during stagger phases.
category_weaknesses_bosses: Boss guides are limited by pre-release balance — attack patterns, damage values, and phase thresholds may shift significantly at launch. Some boss mechanics interact unpredictably with certain Familiar abilities, and the Reincarnation loop's effect on boss AI is not fully documented. Players report that certain ailment-immune bosses in later chapters resist conventional strategies, forcing experimentation with unconventional build archetypes.

category_faq_bosses_q_0: What is the hardest boss in Beast of Reincarnation?
category_faq_bosses_a_0: The First Bloom Avatar is the most challenging encounter, requiring mastery of all combat systems across four phases with escalating enrage timers and a final phase that demands perfect Signal Skill execution.
category_faq_bosses_q_1: Can I skip boss fights using Reincarnation loops?
category_faq_bosses_a_1: No — Reincarnation loops reset your progress within the loop but do not skip boss encounters. They can however reset boss enrage timers, giving you another chance at a clean execution.
category_faq_bosses_q_2: Do boss attack patterns change after Reincarnation?
category_faq_bosses_a_2: Yes — after each Reincarnation loop, bosses gain slight AI modifications (faster reactions, new combo chains) to prevent players from memorizing a single solution.

category_intro_characters: Characters in Beast of Reincarnation are defined by their primary Status Ailment, faction allegiance, and Familiar synergy. Each hero brings a unique combat identity — from Lute's versatile ailment application to Dana's sustain-focused tank support. The Reincarnation mechanic allows players to experience different character builds across loops, with Memory Fragments persisting between cycles to unlock new skill tree branches.
category_mechanics_characters: Each character has a primary Status Ailment that defines their combat role (Knockdown, Shock, Freeze, Bleed, Burn, Poison). Characters gain skill tree points per level, with branching paths that determine their archetype (DPS, Tank, Support, Hybrid). Familiar pairings enhance specific ailments — the Abyssal Direwolf amplifies Burn damage while the Meadow Sprite boosts healing. The bond system between Emma and Koo is central to combat effectiveness, as synchronized attacks trigger bonus Signal Skills.
category_weaknesses_characters: Character guides are constrained by pre-release balance — skill values, ailment durations, and Familiar synergy bonuses may change at launch. The meta ranking assumes optimal play and best-in-slot equipment, which may not reflect casual player experience. Some characters have anti-synergy with certain Familiars that isn't fully documented, leading to unexpected DPS drops.

category_faq_characters_q_0: Which character is best for beginners?
category_faq_characters_a_0: Lute is the most beginner-friendly character — his Knockdown ailment is intuitive, his DPS Burst build has a clear rotation, and his high damage ceiling forgives execution mistakes.
category_faq_characters_q_1: How do Memory Fragments affect character builds?
category_faq_characters_a_1: Memory Fragments persist across Reincarnation loops and unlock additional skill tree branches. This allows a single character to access hybrid build paths that aren't available in a single playthrough.
category_faq_characters_q_2: Can I use multiple characters simultaneously?
category_faq_characters_a_2: The tag system lets you switch between two active characters mid-combo, enabling cross-character ailment chains. However, each Reincarnation loop focuses on one primary character with a secondary tag partner.

category_intro_combat: Combat in Beast of Reincarnation revolves around the tag combo system, where stacking Status Ailments through coordinated attacks triggers devastating Signal Skills. The Reincarnation loop adds strategic depth — each reset preserves knowledge and Memory Fragments while resetting encounter states, allowing players to refine their execution. Mastering the interplay between ailments, Signal timing, and Familiar abilities is essential for surviving the game's increasingly demanding encounters.
category_mechanics_combat: The combat system operates on a chain reaction principle: apply Status Ailments → stack combos → trigger Signal Skills for burst damage. Each character has a primary ailment that chains with other characters' ailments in specific sequences (Knockdown → Shock → Freeze → Shatter). Signal Skills are powerful cooldown abilities that deal bonus damage based on the number of stacked ailments. The tag system allows mid-combo character switching, enabling cross-ailment chains. Familiar abilities provide passive bonuses and active interrupts on separate cooldowns.
category_weaknesses_combat: Combat system depth means guides may oversimplify complex ailment interactions. Reincarnation loop combat modifiers are not fully documented — some encounters gain new attack patterns after loops. The tag combo window timing is reportedly tight (within 0.5s), making consistent execution challenging. Ailment immunity on certain late-game enemies invalidates some combo strategies.

category_faq_combat_q_0: What is the most important combat mechanic to learn first?
category_faq_combat_a_0: Tag combo chains are the foundation — learning to switch characters mid-ailment to stack combos is more impactful than any individual Signal Skill or Familiar ability. Practice the basic Knockdown→Shock chain before advancing.
category_faq_combat_q_1: How tight is the tag combo timing window?
category_faq_combat_a_1: The tag switch window is approximately 0.5 seconds after an ailment application. This is tight but learnable with practice. Some equipment and Familiar bonuses extend this window slightly.
category_faq_combat_q_2: Do Reincarnation loops make combat easier or harder?
category_faq_combat_a_2: Both — loops reset boss enrage timers (easier) but bosses gain slight AI modifications after each loop (harder). The net effect is a strategic tool for retrying difficult encounters with preserved knowledge.

category_intro_items: Items in Beast of Reincarnation span combat consumables, crafting materials, equipment upgrades, and rare Blight-derived artifacts. The crafting system ties directly into exploration — Blight-corrupted regions yield unique materials that can be purified into powerful enhancement items. Equipment follows a tier system from Common to Legendary, with set bonuses that amplify specific build archetypes.
category_mechanics_items: The item system has three tiers of interaction: consumables (immediate combat effects), materials (crafting inputs), and equipment (persistent stat bonuses). Blight Materials are unique items harvested from corrupted zones that require purification at Research Enclave facilities before use. Equipment sets provide escalating bonuses — 2-piece and 4-piece set effects that amplify specific ailment interactions. Rare drops from bosses include Memory Fragments and Blight Cores used for high-tier crafting.
category_weaknesses_items: Drop rates and crafting costs are based on pre-release data and may change at launch. The Blight purification system's exact requirements and success rates are not fully documented. Some legendary items have conflicting set bonuses with popular build archetypes, requiring careful planning.

category_intro_platforms: Beast of Reincarnation is built on Unreal Engine 5, targeting current-gen consoles and PC with specific optimizations for each platform. Performance considerations differ significantly between PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC configurations, with the PC version offering the most customization for graphics and control settings.
category_mechanics_platforms: The game supports keyboard/mouse and controller input on PC, with full gamepad support on consoles. The tag combo system's 0.5-second timing window is consistent across platforms, though input latency varies. PC players can remap controls and adjust sensitivity, while console players benefit from optimized haptic feedback. Cross-save functionality between platforms is planned but not confirmed for launch.
category_weaknesses_platforms: Platform-specific performance benchmarks are based on pre-release builds and may not reflect launch optimization. Console performance modes (Quality vs Performance) may have different ailment timing window feel due to frame rate differences. VRAM requirements for PC are estimates and may increase with final texture assets.

category_faq_platforms_q_0: Which platform is best for competitive combat?
category_faq_platforms_a_0: PC at 60+ FPS offers the most precise tag combo timing due to lower input latency and higher frame rates. The 0.5-second combo window feels more forgiving at higher frame rates.
category_faq_platforms_q_1: Does the game support cross-save between platforms?
category_faq_platforms_a_1: Cross-save functionality is planned but not confirmed for launch. Check official announcements closer to release for platform-specific save transfer options.
category_faq_platforms_q_2: Is an SSD required on PC?
category_faq_platforms_a_2: Yes — Unreal Engine 5's streaming system requires fast storage. An SSD is listed as a minimum requirement, and HDD users will experience significant loading stutters during region transitions.

category_intro_story: The narrative of Beast of Reincarnation follows Emma and her Blight-afflicted dog Koo through a cyclical journey across Blighted Japan. The Reincarnation mechanic is both a gameplay system and a narrative device — each loop reveals deeper layers of the world's lore, with the player's growing knowledge mirroring Emma's own understanding. Story choices across loops have permanent consequences through Memory Fragments, leading to multiple distinct endings.
category_mechanics_story: The story operates on a branching path system influenced by key decisions at Research Enclave checkpoints. Each Reincarnation loop unlocks new dialogue options and story branches based on accumulated Memory Fragments. The relationship between Emma and Koo is the emotional core — their bond level affects available story choices and determines access to the secret ending. Environmental storytelling through Blight-corrupted ruins reveals the First Bloom's true origin across multiple loops.
category_weaknesses_story: Story guides contain spoilers by nature — the Reincarnation loop means 'optimal' story paths may miss the emotional impact of discovering consequences naturally. Some ending requirements involve hidden conditions across multiple loops that are not fully documented. The relationship between gameplay Reincarnation and narrative Reincarnation has subtleties that casual players may overlook.

category_faq_story_q_0: How many endings does Beast of Reincarnation have?
category_faq_story_a_0: There are 4 main endings (True, Secret, Normal A, Normal B) plus a Bad ending for failing core objectives. The True Ending reveals the complete lore and is considered the canonical conclusion.
category_faq_story_q_1: Does the Reincarnation mechanic affect the story?
category_faq_story_a_1: Absolutely — Reincarnation is both a gameplay and narrative mechanic. Each loop unlocks new story branches through Memory Fragments, and the True Ending requires information gathered across multiple loops.
category_faq_story_q_2: How do I unlock the Secret Ending?
category_faq_story_a_2: The Secret Ending requires maximum bond level between Emma and Koo, achieved through specific dialogue choices and combat synergy actions throughout the game. It plays as a post-credits scene after the True Ending.

category_intro_world: The world of Beast of Reincarnation is Blighted Japan — a version of the country devastated by the First Bloom in 2026, where crystalline Blight structures pulse with bioluminescence across ruined cityscapes and corrupted wilderness. Each region presents unique environmental hazards, enemy types, and lore fragments that tell the story of civilization's collapse. Exploration rewards are tied to the Reincarnation loop, with certain areas only accessible after specific loop milestones.
category_mechanics_world: The open world is divided into distinct regions, each with a Blight corruption level that affects enemy density, environmental hazards, and available loot. Regions unlock progressively through story progression, with endgame zones requiring Reincarnation loop completion. Blight Zones are high-risk areas with rare materials but increased enemy aggression. Fast travel between discovered checkpoints becomes available after region purification, and the Research Enclave serves as a central hub for crafting and story interactions.
category_weaknesses_world: World layout and region content may be adjusted before launch. Blight corruption mechanics interact with the Reincarnation system in ways not fully documented — some regions reportedly change after loops. The exact boundary between accessible and locked content per loop milestone is still being balanced.

category_faq_world_q_0: How does Blight corruption affect exploration?
category_faq_world_a_0: Higher corruption increases enemy density and aggression while adding environmental hazards. It also yields rarer materials — the risk-reward tradeoff is central to exploration strategy. Purification can reduce local corruption levels.
category_faq_world_q_1: Can I access all regions in a single loop?
category_faq_world_a_1: No — certain endgame regions require Reincarnation loop milestones. The First Bloom Crater specifically requires completing the main story first, and some Blight Zones only appear after specific loop events.
category_faq_world_a_2: The Research Enclave is the game's central hub — a safe zone with crafting stations, purification facilities, story NPCs, and fast travel connections to all discovered checkpoints. It's unlocked in Chapter 2 and expands as you progress.
